profile.design: Same ex-post reference trade-copy demand and withdrawal policies as the earlier comparison. Reuse the global pool; buy only the entry-time shortfall. No purchases tied to the reference calendar. Funding and physical live cap remain relaxed in this matched-demand bridge; fixed-R pools are studied separately.

base_config.description: Headline. Every Apex payout rule switched on, and our own behaviour is to request $500 -- the firm's minimum -- from each account every calendar month, carrying unpayable months as a backlog.
